texts: bad: "times X to Y" has no slot that fits — the parse files "to the new-moon spring tide" as a spatial destination for the timing event, asserting that something travels to the tide, which the sentence never says; the only licensed alternative (the bare "to" oblique) would instead feed the purpose machinery and derive an aim the sentence never states. Say the alignment with a plain temporal clause instead, splitting the scheduling and the timing into two finite clauses: "Each Keeper schedules the salt-bloom harvest, and the harvest happens during the new-moon spring tide."
